At which station do they transfer? Answer with the station name exactly as printed on the map.

Answer the question using the image. Think it through, then give the answer exactly as written on the map (just the name, nothing else).
End your reply with a final line of the form:

content:
The best trip is to ride the **D** from 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr northwest to **59 St-Columbus Circle**, where the map shows an in-station transfer to the **1** train. The D runs along the diagonal without intermediate stops. The 1 then stops only at 50 St before reaching Times Sq-42 St, for one intermediate stop after the transfer.

The alternative, riding the D/F to 34 St-Herald Sq and changing to the N/Q/R, takes three intermediate stops, so it is worse.

FINAL ANSWER: 59 St-Columbus Circle
